invariants.rationale: Method always returns a Fixed instance, never null.
Every returned Fixed encodes the input value.
If value == 0, result is zero; otherwise, result comes from cache only for matching values.

invariants.expression: value >= -10 && value <= 100 && value == (int)value ? result == cache[(int)value + 10] : true
invariants.rationale: Result comes from cache exactly when the value is in the cacheable range and is an integer.
When input is zero, returned value is the singleton zero instance.
